title: Tiny, cute gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bagGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5f8f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d92b62'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M 36 34 Q 36 18 50 18 Q 64 18 64 34' fill='none' stroke='#ffd1e0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 36 34 Q 36 20 50 20 Q 64 20 64 34' fill='none' stroke='#ff87ab' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bag body -->
  <path d='M 26 34 L 74 34 L 70 88 L 30 88 Z' fill='url(#bagGrad)'/>
  <!-- side shading -->
  <path d='M 26 34 L 34 34 L 37 88 L 30 88 Z' fill='#ff87ab' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- top fold -->
  <rect x='26' y='34' width='48' height='7' rx='2' fill='#ff9dbb'/>
  <rect x='26' y='39' width='48' height='2' fill='#b81f50'/>
  <!-- ribbon -->
  <rect x='44' y='34' width='12' height='54' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='44' y='34' width='12' height='5' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <rect x='47' y='34' width='2' height='54' fill='#f5b800' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- bow -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(-18 40 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='40' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(18 60 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffd23f' transform='rotate(-18 40 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='40' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffd23f' transform='rotate(18 60 40)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <!-- pattern dots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='56' r='2' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='2' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
</svg>
